items.event_time_ist: Published ~4:45 AM ET, Oct 14 (2:15 PM IST, Oct 14); Politico IG carousel 7:04 AM PDT Oct 14
items.title: Politico: top Republicans privately concede the House is lost; GOP in triage to save seats and salvage the Senate
items.summary: Politico exclusive (Oct 14): five senior House Republicans, granted anonymity to speak candidly, told Politico the House has 'all but slipped away' and the party's goal is now to 'save as many Republican seats as we can.' One lawmaker blamed Trump: 'President Trump has made this election all about himself. Now we have to survive that political storm.' Republicans have already cut off spending for Rep. Miller-Meeks (IA), Rep. Kean (NJ) and retiring Rep. Bacon's Omaha district, with more cuts expected; one member predicted Democrats pick up ~10 seats. Journalist Tara Palmeri's Red Letter (Oct 14) independently reported GOP-consultant pessimism three weeks out ('Republicans have stopped trying to win. Now they're trying to lose by less'), citing an Economist/YouGov Sept 25-28 poll showing independents favor Democrats for Congress 59-27.

items.event_time_ist: Reported ~7:21 AM ET, Oct 14 (4:51 PM IST, Oct 14)
items.title: Top House GOP super PAC abandons bid to beat Rep. Henry Cuellar (D-TX) in a district Republicans redrew for themselves
items.summary: Punchbowl News (via Political Wire, Oct 14): the top House GOP super PAC is cutting its spending to defeat Rep. Henry Cuellar (D-TX), even though Republicans redrew his district in their favor last year. The cut signals how unwieldy the House map has become for the GOP with less than three weeks to Election Day, and follows similar triage cuts in Iowa, New Jersey and Omaha.

items.title: New Suffolk poll: Maine Senate a coin toss — Jackson 49, Collins 47
items.summary: Suffolk University poll published Oct 14 (500 likely voters, landline + cellphone, fielded Oct 8-11, MoE +/-4.4): Troy Jackson (D) 49%, Susan Collins (R) 47% — a tightening from the WaPo-Schar poll (50-46) and Marist (51-47). Collins holds a narrow edge among independents and draws 14% of Trump disapprovers; pollster David Paleologos said 'the race hasn't broken open.' Suffolk also notes independent-voter gains for Josh Turek in Iowa and Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan. In the Maine governor's race, Hannah Pingree (D) led 49-38.

items.event_time_ist: Hearing Oct 14, 2026 (Winston-Salem, NC); reported ~7:17 AM ET, Oct 14
items.title: Federal judge hears challenge today to North Carolina's new mail-ballot rules, one day before early voting starts
items.summary: Raleigh News & Observer (via Political Wire, Oct 14): a federal court in Winston-Salem (Judge Thomas Schroeder) holds a hearing today on a preliminary-injunction challenge to new NC mail-in ballot rules adopted Sept 4 by a party-line vote of the GOP-majority State Board of Elections — mandating rejection of absentee ballots in unsealed inner envelopes without a chance to cure, and permitting standardless signature matching. Plaintiffs (NC Alliance for Retired Americans, NC Asian Americans Together, Down Home NC, individual voters; Elias Law Group) argue thousands of voters face arbitrary disenfranchisement; the RNC and NC GOP were granted intervention to defend the rules alongside the board. NC early voting starts Oct 15.
